actions.description: Each enemy in the swarm's space takes @Damage[1d6[piercing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:20|basic] save) and is exposed to pyrexic malaria. Creatures that fail the saving throw also take @Damage[1d4[bleed]].
actions.name: Swarming Bites

actions.description:
The victim can't reduce its Sickened condition while it's affected by pyrexic malaria

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:20]

Onset 4 days

Stage 1 Sickened 1 (1 day)

Stage 2 Enfeebled 1 and Sickened 1 (1 day)

Stage 3 as stage 2 (1 day)

Stage 4 Unconscious (1 day)

Stage 5 dead
actions.name: Pyrexic Malaria

actions.description: This monster doesn't have a single mind (typically because it's a swarm of smaller creatures), and is immune to mental effects that target only a specific number of creatures. It is still subject to mental effects that affect all creatures in an area.
actions.name: Swarm Mind

name: Fen Mosquito Swarm
publicNotes: When deadly fen mosquitoes gather in large numbers, they form into lethal swarms capable of draining blood at a truly alarming rate. Fen mosquito swarms are typically encountered only in tropical swamps or bogs, but during humid months in spring or summer they can drift into riverine areas or even through the waterfront reaches of settlements.
